query: Tefik Selim Mborja was a part of a party that held power in Albania until what year?

pipeline_result.response: Tefik Selim Mborja served as the general secretary of the Albanian Fascist Party (Albanian: "Partia Fashiste e Shqipërisë" or PFSh) during the Second World War. Therefore, he was a member of the party that held power in Albania until 1943.
retrieved_context: Albanian Fascist Party: The Albanian Fascist Party (Albanian: "Partia Fashiste e Shqipërisë" , or PFSh) was a Fascist organization active during World War II which held nominal power in Albania from 1939, when the country was conquered by Italy, until 1943, when Italy capitulated to the Allies.  Afterwards, Albania fell under German occupation, and the PFSh was replaced by the Guard of Greater Albania.
Tefik Mborja: Tefik Selim Mborja (1888-1954) was an Albanian politician and lawyer.  He served as the general secretary of the Albanian Fascist Party during the Second World War.
